central_migration_003.bootstrap: Extend shared Database.migrations to ordered 001->002->003. RoutingService constructor calls db.bootstrap(target_version=3) after MultiAgentService has ensured v2.
central_migration_003.production_apply_boundary: Migration 003 is not applied to production until V2-BD implementation qualification and a later deployment gate.

node_database_bootstrap.bootstrap: Empty node.db executes schema v1 inside BEGIN IMMEDIATE, sets PRAGMA user_version=1, and inserts node_meta key 'schema' containing {version:1,sha256:<schema sha256>}.
node_database_bootstrap.repeat: Verify user_version=1 and exact stored schema sha256; mismatch => NODE_SCHEMA_MISMATCH.

identity_storage.private_key_create: Generate only if no paired device identity exists. Atomic exclusive create; flush/fsync where supported; chmod 0600/best-effort owner-only Windows ACL.
identity_storage.startup_consistency: Derive public key/fingerprint from private key and compare to device.json and node_meta. Any mismatch => NODE_IDENTITY_MISMATCH; never regenerate.
identity_storage.unpaired_key: A generated key may exist before pairing completes and is reused for retry.
identity_storage.pairing_secret_startup: Atomic create once; unused/unexpired pairing rows + missing key => STARTUP_FATAL_PAIRING_KEY_MISSING.

verification_order: constant-time compare SHA-256(pairing_code) to stored hash
verify signature over canonical pair string with submitted public key
BEGIN IMMEDIATE: revalidate unused/unexpired then create device + mark pairing used atomically
exact_pairing_http.authorization: one-time pairing code + Ed25519 proof-of-possession over HTTPS

pairing_begin_tool.signature: async def device_pair_begin(operation_id: str, device_name: str) -> dict
pairing_begin_tool.replay: Same operation re-derives same clear code while pairing unused/unexpired. USED replay returns status/device_id without clear code.

verification_order: read raw body with 1 MiB hard cap
parse required headers and integer route_generation/timestamp
verify Ed25519 signature over raw-body SHA-256 canonical string
update last_seen_at_ms and OFFLINE->ONLINE in same transaction
signed_request_verifier.nonce_cleanup: Delete expired nonce rows only after verification transaction; never before duplicate check for current request.

poll.response: HTTP 204 if none; otherwise one command envelope JSON.

command_queue.mutation_idempotency: UNIQUE(operation_id,operation_step) WHERE operation_id IS NOT NULL.
command_queue.create_replay: Same operation_id+step+same request_hash returns existing command. Different hash => COMMAND_CONFLICT.
command_queue.read_commands: operation_id NULL; safe retry may create a new read command.
poll_transaction: requeue expired LEASED commands only when command itself unexpired and device generation unchanged
select oldest QUEUED command for exact device/generation ordered by created_at_ms,command_id
node_receive: if command_id absent insert RECEIVED with request_hash/payload
if present same hash return persisted state/result
result_commit: verify signed request and command device/generation/request_hash
BEGIN IMMEDIATE update central command terminal state/result/error/event
finalize owning high-level operation/proxy state where applicable

PROJECT_REGISTER_ON_DEVICE: central project + project_device_binding persist after probe
operation success only after node binding ACK
routed_workflow_steps.TASK_CREATE: If project is device-bound, create tasks row + task_device_bindings row + TASK_CREATED/TASK_READY events in one BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction.
TASK_CLAIM: require bound device ONLINE before central claim phase1
step 0 TASK_WORKTREE_ENSURE with expiry <= task lease
finalize RUNNING only after successful node result
TASK_COMPLETE: route TASK_WORKTREE_STATUS for device-bound Git task
require clean/valid bound worktree and no non-terminal routed job
routed_workflow_steps.FILE_WRITE_CAS: validate central task lease then route FILE_WRITE_CAS; never call gateway-local CasService for device-bound task.
routed_workflow_steps.FILE_EDIT_CAS: validate central task lease then route FILE_EDIT_CAS; never call gateway-local CasService for device-bound task.

submit_transaction: validate central task lease and immutable task device binding
BEGIN IMMEDIATE create routed_jobs proxy row + JOB_SUBMIT device command step 0
routed_job_proxy.node_submit_replay: Use local V2-A DurableService operation replay to recover same node_job_id after node-agent crash.
routed_job_proxy.offline: Keep last_known_state; do not mark LOST/FAILED and never relaunch elsewhere.

observation.task_jobs: cached central proxy list; works offline
observation.task_job_get: refresh via JOB_GET when online; otherwise cached + device_state=OFFLINE
observation.task_job_result: terminal cached result may replay; otherwise route JOB_RESULT; offline => DEVICE_OFFLINE
observation.task_job_cancel: requires current task lease; route JOB_CANCEL to bound device

exact_flow: validate command unexpired and node task/project binding
read current target hash and require expected hash
write same-directory temp, fsync, verify intended hash
BEGIN IMMEDIATE set COMMITTED and node command SUCCEEDED
node_cas.restart_reconcile: If current target already equals intended hash, finalize without second write. PREPARED may perform a new replace only while command unexpired; otherwise IN_DOUBT/ABORT as frozen prelock dictates.

node_durable_jobs.service: Existing V2-A DurableService only; no MultiAgentService/OAuth on node.
node_durable_jobs.node_agent_restart: DurableService reconciles same local process; node service then re-associates node_routed_jobs and reports gateway.

exact_cli.pair_code_file: Read one UTF-8 line; trim CR/LF only; delete before any network request; deletion failure exit 2 with PAIRING_CODE_FILE_DELETE_FAILED.
exact_cli.run: Loads origin/root/device ID exclusively from verified device.json; CLI cannot override paired origin/root.
exact_cli.status: Local-only: identity fingerprint/device_id/route_generation/runtime lock state/node DB schema; never print private key.
exact_cli.doctor: No mutation/pairing. Check HTTPS reachability, clock skew estimate, root canonicalization, runtime writeability, cryptography Ed25519 availability.
